effect_description_eng:
＜Barrier＞ (When this Digimon would be deleted in battle, by trashing the top card of your security stack, prevent that deletion.)
[When Digivolving] You may use 1 option card that has [Plug-In] in its name or that's yellow from the hand with the cost reduced by 2.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] If this Digimon has [Sakuyamon] in its name, you may use 1 option card that has [Plug-In] in its name or that's yellow from the hand with the cost reduced by 2.
